notes: RPC reads and public API reads only; no wallet, key or transaction.
Timestamps are UTC ISO 8601. "not available" means the source does not expose it and it was not estimated.
Raw responses are kept outside the repository; scripts in report/scripts reproduce every file.

blocks.what: JSON-RPC eth_getBlockByNumber: first block at or after each UTC midnight found by interpolation search on block timestamps; blocks(day) = firstBlock(next day) - firstBlock(day). Exact, not sampled.

source.what: Routescan /transactions listing paged newest-first at 100 per page until the first item older than the window; distinct lower-cased `from` per UTC day. Exact for the indexed set, not sampled.

gas.method: gasUsed = burnedFees / gasPrice from the Routescan transaction listing; the division was exact for every transaction (verified against eth_getTransactionReceipt for one transaction: gasUsed 396518 x effectiveGasPrice 196043835401595 = burnedFees 77734909525769646210). "No calldata" means methodId absent, which is a plain native transfer (value may be zero); "with calldata" means a contract call. Not sampled.

totalBlocks.note: latest block number + 1 (block 0 is genesis); from RPC

genesis.note: block 0 carries the same timestamp on 151 and 153 (a template value); block 1 is the first produced block, so chain age is counted from block 1

routescanDailyTxSum.note: sum of the Etherscan-compatible dailytx series from before block 1 to today (today partial)

verified.method: Every verified contract listed (verified=true) and grouped by its verifiedAt month and by its creation month. Exact.

creations.method: Routescan /contracts listing (all contracts, newest first) paged until the first contract created before the window; grouped by createOperation.timestamp month. Counts every contract Routescan indexed, including contracts created by other contracts (factory CREATE / CREATE2), so it is larger than the count of deployment transactions (to == null). Exact.

routescan7d.label: Routescan block listing, every block in the last 7 full UTC days
routescan7d.method: Routescan /blocks listing paged newest first (100 per page) to the start of the window; interval = timestamp difference between consecutive block numbers; empty = txCount 0. Exact for the window, not sampled.

rpcWalk.label: JSON-RPC walk of 1000 consecutive blocks

extraDataAddresses.note: count of distinct 20-byte items in the RLP list in block extraData; present in a minority of blocks; its meaning (the governor or signer set) is not documented on Vine and is unverified

rpcWalk.method: eth_getBlockByNumber with full transactions for every block in a contiguous window ending at the head, plus eth_getBlockReceipts for blocks with transactions; batched JSON-RPC. A contiguous window, so it describes those hours only; it is the cross-check for the Routescan-derived figures.

uniqueAddressesCumulative.note: cumulative count of distinct addresses seen, as Routescan aggregates it; the redbelly.network homepage "Wallets Created" card reads this endpoint

routescanCdn.note: These are the endpoints the redbelly.network homepage JavaScript calls for its "Transactions Processed on Mainnet" and "Wallets Created" cards (seen in the site bundle on 2026-09-12). Not documented by Routescan; no date of last update is given, so the fetch time is the only timestamp.

stake.fact: All nodes must stake 100,000 RBNT in order to participate. This acts as a disincentive to malicious behaviour. If a node is found to have acted maliciously, its stake can be slashed.
As outlined in the Network Governance, all nodes must stake 100,000 RBNT in order to participate.

Each Node Operator, whether it runs a Governor or a Candidate, will need to stake 100,000 RBNT to be eligible to participate in Mainnet. An allowance for this requirement is included in the Early Node Operator Incentive provided to a maximum of the first 600 Node Operators.

The first 200 node operators will receive a signup bonus of 500,000 RBNTs. The next 400 node operators (from 201 to 600) will receive a signup bonus of 250,000 RBNTs. The bonus includes 100,000 RBNTs which will be staked on behalf of the node operator at the time of onboarding.

operatorCount.fact: "Nodes Running: 216" (CMS field NodesRunningNumber in the homepage data; no date attached to the figure). The same block states "Transactions Per Second: 97,500", a benchmark claim, not a measured mainnet rate.

Redbelly's optimal performance is achieved with a validator set of 200 governor nodes. Nodes are split into candidates and governors; governors participate in consensus, candidates wait to be rotated in.
Reward model assumes a stable network configuration of n=600 nodes and m=100 governors (500 candidates).
Node Operator submissions closed: "We have been overwhelmed with responses and will now take some time to work through them."

RESEARCH.md source log (2026-09-11): "Node client is an rbbc binary with genesis and config template; 100,000 RBNT stake; 400-operator target", from Vine node guides, community node repos and a CoinMarketCap summary via search excerpts, confidence medium. The 400 figure was not found on Vine on 2026-09-12; Vine gives 200 governors and a 600-operator incentive cap.

Measured: 219 distinct 20-byte addresses appear in the extraData of 134 of the 1000 walked mainnet blocks (3178593 to 3179592). Whether this list is the governor set is not documented; treat as unverified.
